The field harmonizes — apparent power drops toward actual productive demand. Now let's move into what you should expect to see. That green reactive waste layer has virtually disappeared — you're seeing the electromagnetic field compress to align with your actual production demand. Dark blue kVA drops close to light blue kW. Power factor locks at 99.5%. The savings are substantial: approximately $50,400 per month, roughly $605,000 annually. Against an estimated $400,000 installation investment, you're looking at about an 8-month payback period. After that breakeven point, every operating hour is recovered value flowing directly to your bottom line. Your production rhythm stays exactly the same — five weekday blocks, weekend valleys — but the efficiency transformation is dramatic. That's electromagnetic stewardship — and that's the Unity standard.
